description: Test data manifest for tools/fetch/samples.sh and golden.sh (docs/13-testing.md, docs/test-photo-sources.md). Files are CC0 (corpus, golden tier 1) or freely licensed (golden tier 2). The file list is filled by `samples.sh --refresh` on a machine that can reach the hosts; it ships empty because rawdb.dnglab.org and raw.pixls.us were blocked where this manifest was written.

policy.note: Mirrors the constants in ymfetch.py, which enforces them. Anything else (CC BY-NC-SA, unknown, unverified) is excluded.

rawdb.name: RawDB
rawdb.licence_rule: CC0 1.0 only, read per file from the 'license' field of the API answer.
rawdb.status: UNVERIFIED against the live host (blocked from the authoring environment). The answer layout (path, size, sha256, license per file) comes from docs/test-photo-sources.md; the download URL comes from a url field in the answer, an absolute /path, or file_url_template. `--refresh` probes the first URL before writing anything.

pixls.name: raw.pixls.us
pixls.licence_rule: CC0 only. Some older files are CC BY-NC-SA and must be excluded. The directory listing does not state a licence, so listed files go to 'pending' and join the corpus only after a manual check (`samples.sh --promote`).
pixls.status: UNVERIFIED against the live host (blocked from the authoring environment). Fetch politely: one connection, identified user agent.

playraw.name: discuss.pixls.us, Play Raw category
playraw.licence_rule: CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA, read by a person from the post, then added with `golden.sh --add-tier2`.
playraw.status: UNVERIFIED against the live host (blocked from the authoring environment).
